title: Conditional κ = 7.69553898621543·10⁻⁴: the full transcript stage stack on #315's p = 10 word, with a shared-donor closure kernel (+0.697% over #315)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.69553898621543·10⁻⁴: the full transcript stage stack on #315's p = 10 word, with a shared-donor closure kernel (+0.697% over #315)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-p10-transcript-stages/` (#315's package with the transcript stages of the gen4/gen5/gen5b lineage re-derived on the p = 10 word), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 769553898621543/10¹⁸ = 7.69553898621543·10⁻⁴**: +0.697% over #315 (7.64230861320245·10⁻⁴), +0.576% over #316, +0.180% over #317 and +0.169% over #319. (The first version of this PR, with a packed kernel, was 7.69198971896986·10⁻⁴.) Bit root 7.70147·10⁻⁴, complex 7.72714·10⁻⁴ (#315's centre-sharing supplier, unchanged): the bit side binds, 0.33% below the cap.

## Stages (each predicted by the φ ledger and verified exactly)

The φ ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(100/r), deficit 2,040 per replica, normalized ×12) reproduces #315's κ exactly; every row below is a full `verify.replay` of the package cut after that stage, and every prediction matched to all digits.

| stage (mechanism credited) | on the p = 10 word | κ |
|---|---|---|
| #315 | — | 7.64230861320245·10⁻⁴ |
| concave-descent retiming (#287/#279; = #316's 480 gates) | 480 gates, {1: −960, 2: +480, 16: −480, 17: +960, 18: −480} | 7.65146115390441·10⁻⁴ |
| target-prefix squares (eumemic #268; rohanarun #273/#287) | 120 groups | 7.65802240659923·10⁻⁴ |
| collective response kernels as a **shared-donor closure** (Dugongue #254/#259/#272; our multi-donor form #282/#290/#299; the shared-donor idea of eumemic's #319) | 1,047 entries, entrance rank 1,200: per entrance E a maximum-weight closure where a pivot's donors are its representation in a response basis and a donor pays its split cost once however many entries it serves (1–31 donors per entry, a donor shared by up to 30); 24,203 rank-1 lines + 10,541 exact rank 2–14 frame intersections searched, 16 seeds, the 7 sink helpers kept free; φ −1,601.5 (the earlier restart packing gave −1,356.0, #319's appended rank-1 entries −55.1) | 7.68105513378630·10⁻⁴ |
| early helper restorations (utcorvusvolat-dotcom #280; endpoint banking #283; ours #295) | 240 helpers | 7.68740991856791·10⁻⁴ |
| terminal sinks (Dugongue #283; ours #295) | 7 (R 8,230 → 8,223) | 7.69153177272007·10⁻⁴ |
| addition reordering (ours, #299/#306) | 133 moves, φ −276.09 | **7.69553898621543·10⁻⁴** |

A second descent pass and a second reorder round were searched after the sinks and after the reorder and found nothing (0 gates, 0 moves). A second kernel round after the closure finds 4 entries (φ −0.77) and is not a stage. Levers of #309/#312 checked and absent on this word: zero-response singles (none), plateau retiming (covered by the descent2 search, 0), local dirty-response transport (no positive closure).

## What changed in #315's package

* Stage transforms and raw-ledger rebinds read h, v, m, centres, scatter reads and deficit from `word_pins.shape()`; every word-dependent count is a strict `word_pins.expect` pin recorded by `discovery/repin.py` (75 pins).
* Downstream checks extended for the stages: lowering completes restored helpers with P_σ + I − P_E on the post-sink register count; geometry checks one restored (σ, E) pair exactly; bank charts restored helpers by (σ, E); the prime check keeps the determinant obligation of frames removed by retiming; the scalar check replays the source program over all 10,150 columns and the emitted word over its 10,143; math/finite price the completion-rank histogram; the finite check re-asserts every stage receipt and exactly one raw-ledger receipt per stage.
* Bank tiling: #315's `tile()` runs out of rank-4 filler blocks after the restorations; an `economy_tile()` fallback adds patterns such as (19⁴, 20, 4), (18⁴, 20, 4²), (16⁵, 20), (3²⁰, 20²) — every bank exactly width 100 and full, no padding (85,578 banks per stage, literal stock 658,290); the no-stage word still tiles with the original search. The kernel entrance rank and the restoration saving must be multiples of 5 for the width-100 banks (1,200 and 240 here).
* Search tools in `discovery/` (descent and target search, the collective census and restart packing, the restore, sink, reorder and descent2 builders), documented in `discovery/README.md`; `STAGES-PROOF.md`; #315's README and PR statement kept as `README-PR315.md`, `PR-STATEMENT-PR315.md`.

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-p10-transcript-stages/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python -B research/five-stage-p10-transcript-stages/verify.py --output /tmp/p10-stages-verification   # about 3 minutes
    python -B research/five-stage-p10-transcript-stages/bitword/producer/regenerate.py --work /tmp/p10-regeneration

`PASS_IMMUTABLE_P10_TRANSCRIPT_STAGES_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`, 15 required stages each with an omitted-stage control; passes on macOS and on Linux with the same manifest sha256 (`adc6bc29…`), and the generator check reproduces the five pinned bit-word files. The workflow (#315's, renamed) runs both on Ubuntu.

## Scope

Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses of the source527 lineage (no Lean certificate for the bit side). #315 is open; its word, banks and complex supplier are inherited unchanged except the re-pinned literals and the tiling fallback.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The p = 10 word, its package and the centre-sharing complex supplier are DreamingOfClouds' (#315, on #276/#285/#304); the descent retiming and target stages are rohanarun's (#287/#279/#273/#316; target-prefix mechanism eumemic's #268); the response-kernel mechanism and collective kernels are Dugongue's (#254/#259/#272/#283), shared-donor selection eumemic's idea (#319, read as a description), restart packing rohanarun's (#300); early restorations utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#280); the reorder stage, the multi-donor kernel stage and the gen5 ports are ours (#290/#295/#299/#306). This package contributes the re-derivation of the whole stack at p = 10, the shape-parametrised stages and pins, the tiling fallback and the checks.
